info.name: Flexi Desk — All Mobile APIs
info.description:
Source-derived inventory of every registered route in routes/api.php: 111 route declarations, 112 explicit method/path combinations. Includes current mobile ticketing endpoints, legacy v1 endpoints, and diagnostics. Import the environment, enter your credentials, and send Authentication / POST /api/auth/login. Login stores token automatically; OTP stores reset_token separately. Base URL excludes /api. No live API calls were made. Legacy dependency warnings are documented per request. Send requests individually; running all requests will create/update/delete records and send emails or push notifications.

Updated 2026-11-25: three-level ticket hierarchy, duplicate 409 examples, reply validation, and audio reference handling. Saved responses use dummy IDs; use lookup endpoints to obtain actual IDs. No live API requests were sent.

Ticket access depends on requester/assignee/admin checks and the employee reporting hierarchy. Creation resolves the assignee server-side; fetch Type → Category → Sub-Category IDs from the lookup endpoints first. Notifications need working Firebase credentials.

Duplicate subtype rule: HTTP 409 with code=duplicate_active_ticket when the same requester has an Open or in_progress ticket with the same ticketsubtype_id. Response fields existing_ticket_id, existing_ticket_status and existing_ticket_url identify it; redirect_url is the web detail page. Mobile clients should show message and navigate to existing_ticket_id rather than retrying creation. Closed/Feedback tickets do not block creation. Both tickettype_id and ticketsubtype_id are validated as integers when present.

Hierarchy: tickettype_id → ticket_category_id → ticketsubtype_id. API keys and old subtype IDs are preserved. New creation requires a mapped ticketsubtype_id. Category may be omitted by older mobile clients and is inferred. Invalid/unmapped combinations return JSON 422; active duplicates return 409.

formdata.description: Optional for older mobile clients: derived from the mapped ticketsubtype_id when omitted. When provided, it must match the Type/Sub-Category hierarchy.
Required integer. Use an ID from the selected Category’s sub-categories endpoint.

Ticket access depends on requester/assignee/admin checks and the employee reporting hierarchy. Creation resolves the assignee server-side; fetch Type → Category → Sub-Category IDs from the lookup endpoints first. Notifications need working Firebase credentials.

Updated comment rules: provide non-whitespace description OR a file OR a voice note. Empty replies return JSON 422. Description max 10,000 characters; attachment max 5 MB; decoded voice note max 10 MB. voice_note accepts an audio data URI (webm/ogg/mp4/mpeg/mp3/wav, optional codecs) or Base64. Audio is stored as a file; notifications include its reference, not Base64. The mobile UI should block Send during recording/encoding. Optional is_recording=1 is rejected.

formdata.description: Optional string, max 10,000 characters. Required content unless a file or valid voice note is supplied.
formdata.value: Dummy ticket details for API testing.

formdata.description: Optional audio data URI/Base64; decoded max 10 MB. Leave disabled unless testing a real recording.
Optional. Sending 1 is rejected with 422; wait until recording/encoding is finished.
